description.value:
Marks a technological construct. It can be modified like a technological device; a helpless mechanical creature can normally be disabled after at least 1 full round with Disable Device or Use Technological Device at DC 15 + half its Hit Dice, subject to GM adjudication.

This reusable record defines shared conversion behavior. Individual actors carry exact printed exceptions and totals.

system.source: World of Warcraft: Monster Guide, pp. 192
